headline: For exact-rank-three Parseval frames with maximum physical leverage tending to zero, arbitrary independent cap-one triangular arrays in the finite-variance/tight-mean-covariance Lindeberg class have output densities converging uniformly to an affine Gaussian quadratic-form density, hence global limsup at most 3sqrt(2); the bound is sharp in this scoped class.

theorem.scope: R_m^T R_m=I_3, max row leverage ->0, fixed Lambda with three |lambda_j|>=1, independent physical densities <=1, finite means/variances, projected mean and covariance convergent, vector Lindeberg.
theorem.conclusion: If G~N(h,Sigma) is the projected CLT limit, then ||p_m-p_Gquadratic||_infty->0 and limsup ||p_m||_infty<=3sqrt(2). Cap-one gives Sigma>=I_3/12. Centered unit-interval diffuse banks with Lambda=(1,1,-1) attain the limit 3sqrt(2).
theorem.not_full_target: Finite variance, tight projected mean/covariance and Lindeberg are explicit extra witness-class assumptions; unrestricted QFORM allows their failure.

required_source_applied.application: Theorem F applied to each actual finite exact-rank-three frame once max leverage<=1/2: |phi_m(t)|<=min(1,(4pi)^(3/2)|t|^-3/2). Dominated convergence upgrades the joint CLT to L1 characteristic-function convergence and uniform output-density convergence.

partner_results_applied.application: Arbitrary-mean Gaussian ceiling with covariance floor Sigma>=I/12 gives ||p_infty||_infty<=3sqrt(2).

Latest rare-fragment family has leverage 1/m, projected mean O(1/m), covariance I/12+O(1/m), and Lindeberg cost O(1/m), so the new theorem gives global limsup<=3sqrt(2). Combining with the partner mixture expansion p(0)->3sqrt(2) yields ||p_Qm||_infty->3sqrt(2).

correction_status: Live CORRECTION_INBOX reread at source_control_commit_pre_handoff; no later correction found that retracts the product-source Fresnel theorem, multivariate Lindeberg-Feller step, cap-one variance floor, or Gaussian endpoint theorem used here.
unresolved_implication: A diffuse exact-rank-three witness above 3sqrt(2) must fail Lindeberg, fail projected mean/covariance tightness, or have no finite covariance; alternatively leave the diffuse regime via intermediate/macroscopic leverage. Full QFORM remains open.
next_step: Construct or exclude source-valid diffuse non-Lindeberg triangular arrays with order-one spectral jumps not reducible to a Gaussian plus independent shift; in parallel test intermediate-leverage finite/mesoscopic exact-spectrum geometries.
